why: TERMINAL CREATE COST item 2 (STATUS 11836, 11933): New Column, New Row and Cmd-D adopt a pane's strip model and views made ahead out of every window (3.5 ms of the key turn). Two App parts, both on App-only types: PaneController.Spare (builds PaneContentView, which lives in CmuxNextApp; most of its lines moved from PaneController.init), and WorkspaceContentController.refillPaneSpare with its layout-motion observer (shown and still gating, no make in a spring frame). The generic part (IdleSpare) is in CmuxNextWakeups. Moving the gating into CmuxNextLayout would add a new Layout API before PL-motion-core answers STATUS 11937.
